title: Test Result
description: Schema for a single test result entry in the QA Report. Covers both Vitest and Playwright test results.

test_id.description: Unique test identifier within the QA Report.

test_file.description: Path to the test file relative to project root.

test_name.description: Full test name (describe block + it block name).

acceptance_criteria.description: List of acceptance criterion IDs this test validates.

failure_message.description: If status is FAILED or FLAKY, the error message from the test runner.

severity_if_failed.description: Bug severity classification if this test is failing.
